item.title: Baugh Bulldozes FSU as Gators End Seminoles’ Season - The Florida Star | The Georgia Star
item.description: GAINESVILLE - Jadan Baugh delivered a historic performance Saturday night, rushing for 266 yards and two touchdowns as Florida demolished rival Florida State 40-21 at The Swamp, denying the Seminoles bowl eligibility for the second consecutive season. Baugh’s 38 carry masterpiece marked the second highest single game rushing total in Gators history, trailing only Emmitt Smith’s 316 yards in 1989. […]

item.title: IN MEMORIAM: Civil Rights Icon Reverend Jesse Louis Jackson, Sr. Passes Away at 84 - The Florida Star | The Georgia Star
item.description: NY AMSTERDAM NEWS — In the early 1960s when young activists were fighting against race-based discrimination Jackson was among them, unaware of the role he would play in the Civil Rights Movement over the next several decades. By the time of his passing, he had lived to see the inauguration of a Black president and his work being done by thousands of people from every background.

item.title: Man Released from ICE Custody a Second Time After Warrantless Arrest - The Florida Star | The Georgia Star
item.description: MINNESOTA SPOKESMAN-RECORDER — Garrison Gibson’s attorney confirmed Friday afternoon that he is home with his family and required to wear an ankle monitor while remaining under immigration supervision. The second release followed a series of events that began with a warrantless raid on Gibson’s north Minneapolis home: an entry a U.S. District Court judge later ruled violated the Fourth Amendment.
